instruction: A crisp studio photograph with a full-shot, eye-level view captures an indoor ballet studio with wooden floors and grey walls. On the left, the young girl with dark hair in a bun (R1) in a white tutu smiles while balancing on one leg, her other leg bent outward, holding the grey ballet barre. On the right, the young girl with light brown hair in a bun (R2) in a matching white tutu smiles while balancing on one leg and holding her raised ankle. They pose side-by-side at the barre under soft indoor lighting that illuminates the neutral grey and warm wood tones.
